name: MyPeople Bot
tagline: Shows which data breaches exposed your email and the three fixes that matter
description: Give it an email and it lists the known breaches that contain it, then narrows the response to the three changes worth making first. The same lookup works as a footprint check on you or a vetting pass on a vendor, investor, or partner. Open sources only, and it acts on nobody's behalf without your agreement.
author: StuyBoyNY
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
